newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Boeing appoints new head of Moscow research.
newsitem.headline: Boeing appoints new head of Moscow research.

text.p: Boeing Co has appointed Douglas Davidson, until now commercial manager, as the general director of its technical research centre in Moscow, a company official said on Wednesday.
Davidson replaced fellow-American Vera Stasuk who had been general director for 1-1/2 years, the official told Reuters by telephone.
Boeing Co opened its Moscow centre in 1993 to carry out joint research projects with Russian plane designers and aircraft manufacturers.
The centre is conducting research into new aircraft materials, into structures engineering and noise engineering, aerodynamics and cold weather fuel systems.
It cooperates with Russia's Ilyushin plane design office, the National Institute of Aviation Technology, the Central Aerohydrodynamic Institute and others.
